card.title: Nintendo Wii SD Card does not read

source.title: Nintendo Wii SD Card does not read

claims.statement: Wii SD card not read: check FIL43 and continuity between the slot's CD and CD/WP pins with a card inserted; no continuity means a broken slot—jumper or replace it.

procedure: Check CD to CD/WP continuity with a card inserted.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
